name: meter
description: Meter, the taxi meter and fleet platform, for AI agents. Book, track and cancel your own taxi rides with a price preview and your confirmation; ask about a fleet's trips, bookings, drivers, vehicles, earnings and accounting; guide onboarding; and change settings with a dry run and confirmation. Hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in, no API keys.

interface.longDescription: Meter is the taxi meter and fleet platform: drivers run a meter in the Meter app, fleets manage drivers, vehicles, fares, scheduled bookings and money, and riders book rides from local taxi companies. This plugin connects your agent to the hosted Meter MCP server with your own Meter sign-in, so it sees exactly what you see. Riders can book a ride with their usual taxi company, see the price first and confirm before anything is booked, pay on Meter's own checkout page rather than in the chat, follow the driver and cancel with the fee shown up front; the agent never handles card details. Fleet owners get answers about trips, bookings, drivers, vehicles, earnings and accounting, a guided onboarding, and settings changes that apply only after a dry run and their confirmation. Drivers see their own trips and pay stubs.
defaultPrompt: Book me a ride to the airport at 6am with my usual taxi company.
How much did my fleet earn last week, and which driver had the most trips?
Which bookings are still unassigned for tomorrow morning?
